lines: Hello, I’m calling on behalf of Eleanor Price as her power of attorney. I need to report her debit card lost and have a new one issued immediately.
This is urgent. Eleanor’s card was just stolen, and fraudulent charges are happening now. I need to block the card and send a replacement immediately to prevent further loss.
Sure, her full name is Eleanor Price, birth date July 22, 1946, and her home ZIP code is 01060.
